text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Boom, boom, resonated the drums, 
as if heralding the festival's end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the gentle moonlight, that 
night――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: grew quietly, peacefully deeper.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: …'Tis a fine night.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aye. The moon's right pretty too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It really is all over, huh… 
The Goshiki Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It felt like it took forever to get 
here, 
but it flew by in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hey, guys.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Did you see it too?

text_block_list.name: Sacred Steeds
text_block_list.text:
We did. 
Yes, we did.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lady Mayano asked of it as well. 
Thou speakest of that wondrous place, dost 
thou not?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
They said they heard it there too. 
A voice calling their own names.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
…I wonder if the people who called out to 
us 
are underneath this very same sky.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they're gazing at the same 
stars as Maya and the rest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, then let us lend our ears! 
…Hmm-hmm, ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“No Reason! 
Blaze a trail through the Senior ranks, 
and show them your glorious uprising!”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heard and acknowledged, thy wish! 
I shall grant it without fail!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's awesome! 
Send a wish down to me too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
To the person I love most, 
I want to show you what I've got――!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Come on, Yukino, you too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Me as well!? 
Umm, well…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
…I promise to stay hale and healthy, 
and keep running with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So please, keep watching over me. 
…Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet-chan. 
Do you think our vow here 
will reach wherever that voice came from?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will. 
It has to.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, tonight is the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai. 
A festival for horse girls and humans 
alike.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
――It's a special festival to celebrate our 
bonds 
with the people who cherish us horse 
girls, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: (That's why――)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: (――I vow. Now and forevermore,)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(that I will always be someone 
worthy of the “name” I bear.)
